events.name: Bash
events.head: Show HEAD, file state and the checkout client code
events.input: $ git rev-parse --short HEAD && git status --short app/src/lib/checkout-client.ts app/src/lib/form-log.ts app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts && wc -l app/src/lib/checkout-client.ts app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts && sed -n 1,165p app/src/lib/checkout-client.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find UTM resolver usages, stale location.search reads, and the checkout route
events.input: $ grep -n "resolveUtm\|tantra_first_touch_utm\|FIRST_TOUCH" -r app/src | head -40; echo ---; grep -rn "location.search" app/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -i "utm\|checkout" | head -20; echo ---; sed -n 1,200p app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the UTM probe and the existing Dodo read helper
events.input: $ cat app/scripts/probe-checkout-utm.mjs; ls app/scripts/.tmp135/dodo.mjs && sed -n 1,60p app/scripts/.tmp135/dodo.mjs | sed -E 's/(sk_|dodo_)[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{8,}/[redacted]/g'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the UTM resolver, list checkout callers, check local servers and Dodo env names
events.input: $ sed -n 40,105p app/src/lib/form-log.ts; echo ---; grep -rn "dodopayments\|startBuildPassCheckout\|staticCheckoutUrl\|startProCheckout" app/src cloud --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" -l | grep -v node_modules | head -30; echo ---; grep -rnE "location\.search" app/src | grep -iE "utm" | head; echo ---; for p in 4322 3000 3001 4321; do curl -s -o /dev/null -m 3 -w "$p %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:$p/vip/; done; grep -n "DODO" app/.env.local | sed -E 's/=.*/=<set>/'; sed -n 1,60p app/src/lib/dodo.ts | grep -n "live\|test\|BASE\|env\."
